connector.name: Vivideo
connector.registryDescription: AI video generation via the Vivideo API: auto or manual mode, avatars, voices, brand kits.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.vivideo.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the egocen-vivideo account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer vv_live_... — your Vivideo API key, created in the app under Settings > More > API Keys.

env.name: VIVIDEO_API_KEY
env.description: Your Vivideo API key (vv_live_...), created in the app under Settings > More > API Keys.
